mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS registerId, r.regist_money AS registFee, r.case_number AS caseNumber, r.real_name AS realName, IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(d.drug_price * p.drug_number) FROM prescription p JOIN drug_info d ON p.drug_id = d.id WHERE p.register_id = r.id AND p.drug_state NOT IN ('已退费','已退药','已作废') ), 0) AS drugTotalFee, IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(t.tech_price) FROM inspection_request i JOIN medical_technology t ON i.medical_technology_id = t.id WHERE i.register_id = r.id AND i.inspection_state NOT IN ('已退费','已作废') ), 0) AS checkTotalFee, IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(t.tech_price) FROM check_request c JOIN medical_technology t ON c.medical_technology_id = t.id WHERE c.register_id = r.id AND c.check_state NOT IN ('已退费','已作废') ), 0) AS inspectionTotalFee, IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(t.tech_price) FROM disposal_request dp JOIN medical_technology t ON dp.medical_technology_id = t.id WHERE dp.register_id = r.id AND dp.disposal_state NOT IN ('已退费','已作废') ), 0) AS disposalTotalFee FROM register r WHERE r.id = #{key} OR r.case_number = #{key} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE prescription SET drug_state = '已缴费' WHERE register_id = #{registerId} AND drug_state = '已开立'
UPDATE check_request SET check_state = '已缴费' WHERE register_id = #{registerId} AND check_state = '待检查'
UPDATE inspection_request SET inspection_state = '已缴费' WHERE register_id = #{registerId} AND inspection_state IN ('已开立','待检查')
UPDATE disposal_request SET disposal_state = '已缴费' WHERE register_id = #{registerId} AND disposal_state = '待处置'
